sections.title: Scheme
sections.sql: select code,name,uri,owner,languages from schemes where id=$1

sections.title: Terms
sections.sql: select code,name,definition,owner,status,review_due from concept_register where scheme_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Labels
sections.sql: select c.code,l.kind,l.lang,l.value from labels l join concepts c on c.id=l.concept_id where c.scheme_id=$1 order by c.code,l.lang,l.kind

sections.title: Review work
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,review_due,reason from review_queue where scheme_id=$1

sections.title: Translation gaps
sections.sql: select code,name,lang from translation_gaps where scheme_id=$1

sections.title: Requests
sections.sql: select c.code,r.title,r.owner,r.due,r.status,r.decision_note from requests r join concepts c on c.id=r.concept_id where c.scheme_id=$1 order by r.due

sections.title: Decision
sections.sql: select version,actor,note,created_at from releases where id=$1

sections.title: Snapshot terms
sections.sql: select c->>'code' code,c->>'uri' uri,c->>'definition' definition,c->>'status' status from releases r,jsonb_array_elements(r.snapshot->'concepts') c where r.id=$1
